jobs.title: Software Engineer 2 - Power
jobs.description:
**Overview**  

The Windows Ecosystem and Commercial Engagement team (WECE) sits at the center of how Microsoft brings the full power of Windows to life across a global ecosystem of partners, customers, and engineering teams. Our mission is to transform strategic priorities into real\-world innovation—connecting technology, insight, and collaboration so Windows continues to deliver outstanding experiences on every device. Within WECE, Hardware Engineering Enablement (HEE) accelerates the integration of modern hardware capabilities into Windows PCs and provides the tools, guidance, and engineering partnership that elevate device quality, performance, efficiency, and user delight across the ecosystem.


Power efficiency and battery life are fundamental to every Windows device—they shape how customers work, create, connect, and experience mobility every day. The Windows Assessment Toolkit (WAT), part of the Windows Assessment and Deployment Kit (ADK), is the trusted measurement platform that OEMs, silicon partners, and retailers rely on to evaluate energy efficiency and bring high\-quality devices to market. Our team owns the power and battery\-life assessments that turn Microsoft’s measurement approach into a credible, scalable ecosystem practice. We are looking for a self\-motivated, innovative, and accountable Software Engineer II to help evolve the next generation of power and energy\-efficiency assessments within WAT. In this role, you will collaborate across Microsoft to enable high\-quality, delightful PC experiences with outstanding battery life, while applying advances in AI and data to make the toolkit smarter, more reliable, and more impactful for the entire Windows ecosystem.

Overview:
**WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING**
At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next\-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. **Together, we advance your career.**
Responsibilities:
**THE ROLE:**
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented Validation Engineer to play a critical role in ensuring the compatibility and reliability of our server hardware and software solutions throughout the product development lifecycle. You will be responsible for designing, executing, and analyzing compatibility tests, driving issue resolution, and contributing to the overall quality and robustness of our products. **THE PERSON:**
The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and meticulous problem\-solver with a strong sense of ownership and a proactive approach to ensuring product quality. You possess excellent attention to detail and natural curiosity to investigate and understand complex system interactions. You are a strong communicator who can effectively collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including development and vendors, to drive issues to resolution. You are organized and results\-oriented, capable of managing multiple tasks and delivering to deadlines. Furthermore, you demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, staying updated with the latest testing methodologies and technologies. jobs.title: 短影音拍攝需求
jobs.description:
**工作內容**
更新日期:2026\-08\-01
--------------------------

在星睿牙醫診所，我們相信每一位牙科助理都是醫療團隊中不可或缺的重要夥伴。工作內容主要為一般牙科助理業務，包括協助醫師進行各項牙科治療、診療器械準備與整理、診間環境維護、器械清潔消毒與滅菌流程，以及協助患者就診與提供貼心照護，讓每位患者都能安心完成治療。


我們重視的不只是完成每天的工作，更希望每位夥伴都能持續成長。診所提供完善的教育訓練制度，由資深同仁循序帶領，讓沒有牙科經驗的新進夥伴也能安心學習。我們鼓勵團隊持續精進專業能力，並提供豐富的學習資源，包含臨床實務、感染控制、數位牙科等相關知識，幫助您累積扎實的專業技能。
如果您喜歡與人互動、具有服務熱忱、願意學習新知識，並期待在一個重視團隊合作、專業成長與工作品質的環境中發展，歡迎加入星睿牙醫診所，一起守護每一位患者的口腔健康，也共同打造更美好的醫療服務體驗
